h7creaturesRumor0.text: That H7 Time Stasis is like inviting a troop off the field for tea: nobody can touch it this round, and next round it's back where it was—only it's missed everything it should've done this round.

h7creaturesRumor1.text: That Wasp Swarm holds a grudge: stinging one troop isn't enough, so it turns to the troop's comrades and goes for the ones that haven't been stung yet.

h7creaturesRumor2.text: A Tornado doesn't care who's friend or foe. Anyone caught in it who survives gets flung off to some random spot nearby.
